steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Invite the product's available QA vendors as required for a usable event.
Verify the event is live before opening the extension dialog.
Open the RFQ Responses tab specified by the case.
Confirm the live RFQ has no vendor responses before cancellation.
Open the Increase Event Time dialog from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the expected extension dialog opened.
Cancel the extension instead of confirming a new time.
Assert that cancelling closes the Increase Event Time dialog.
Verify cancellation did not change the event's live status.
Verify cancellation did not create or alter any vendor responses or bids.
